software.measurement_tree_note: B4 graph admission and row-5 exact-template instantiations were isolated uncommitted changes over the recorded base. Every runtime, kernel, test, and script change was removed before publication; only evidence and documentation remain.

audit_finding.reason_for_screen: The prior completion pass measured B1-B3 and then B5, but never admitted the interpolating B4 verifier graph. B4 was a materially different speculative schedule rather than another closed arithmetic micro-optimization.

admission_policy.correctness: B1-B4 logits, transaction state, GPU acceptance, reject/partial/full commit, forced rollback, correction, dynamic positions, provider output, memory lifecycle, and teardown must match scalar execution.
admission_policy.suite: Promotion requires non-regressive absolute throughput on the full ten-prompt train/heldout/category suite. A favorable single fixed prompt is diagnostic only.
admission_policy.rule: Do not run the full category suite unless an exact one-prompt B4 path clears 50.3 ms per target pass. Do not move the gate after observing the fixed code prompt.

graph_and_correctness_validation.admission: Budget 4 / five target rows was admitted across metadata, compiler/provider, transactional verifier/decode capacity, Python graph validation, and the host-only C++ graph shim. N2 device accept/commit remained limited to B1/B2.
graph_and_correctness_validation.first_graph_failure: The initial B4 graph first diverged after full-attention layer 3. Shared attention, K grid-y, rotary, Conv/GDN snapshots, and selected-row commit were independently exonerated.
graph_and_correctness_validation.root_cause: Dense-BF16 row-5 full-attention V used a prefill reduction that differed by one BF16 bit from the retained c1 arithmetic. A ROW_TILE=5 sibling restored bit equality.

w7900_transaction.scope: B1-B4 eager and graph logits; all 96 Conv/GDN state buffers; GPU/CPU accept; reject/partial/full commit; forced post-commit rollback; correction; dynamic-position reuse; natural provider; clean teardown

graph_and_correctness_validation.final_q6_specialization: Planar-qmicro Q6 BF16 and FP32 ROW_TILE=5 outputs were byte-identical to the retained legacy rowtile oracle on GPU1; the final one-prompt W7900 run remained exact with GPU/CPU acceptance agreement.
graph_and_correctness_validation.post_rejection_cap_gate: 8/8 restored B1-B3 compiler/graph/suite/Q5-dispatch tests passed; compileall and git diff --check passed.

exact_c1_v_fallback.interpretation: Correctness-only five-c1 V decomposition; not a retainable implementation.

dense_q4_q5_row5_specialized_before_q6.admission_result: failed; profile once to distinguish another direct fallback from inherent row cost

final_planar_q6_row5_specialized.admission_result: failed: 61.957 ms/pass exceeds the frozen 50.3-ms full-suite ceiling despite the favorable fixed code prompt

pre_q6_profile.workload: code_merge_intervals, natural25 B4 only, one profiled run, W7900

concrete_remaining_fallback.interpretation: The earlier B5 experiment had specialized row 6 while intentionally leaving unsupported row 5 on the direct body. This was a real remaining B4 implementation omission and justified one final exact ROW_TILE=5 extension.

decision.reason: The frozen preliminary gate failed after the final measured fallback was replaced. The one favorable fixed prompt cannot authorize promotion or a category-suite run under the anti-gaming policy.
decision.reopen_condition: A materially different speculative algorithm, proposer-quality improvement, or hardware primitive that credibly lowers five-row target cost below 50.3 ms/pass; not another rearrangement of the closed exact rowtile families.
